name: Universidad Nebrija
description: At Nebrija University, we are deeply committed to providing exceptional academic training, with a primary focus on enhancing our students' knowledge and fostering their analytical and judgment capabilities within a global context. To achieve this goal, we collaborate with leading companies in each sector to design our study programs and offer invaluable professional internship opportunities to our students. Furthermore, our curriculum includes interdisciplinary subjects to complement their education, ensuring a well-rounded learning experience. With programs available in four modalities - in-person, online, hybrid, or blended - we strive to accommodate our students' professional and personal commitments while facilitating their educational journey.
